BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_DATA_DIR.prompt: Directory holding the database registry and file-backed graph data

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_DATABASE.prompt: Default database when --database is not given

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_NEO4J_PASSWORD.prompt: Neo4j password, for databases registered with --graph-backend neo4j

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_REDIS_URL.prompt: Redis URL with any credentials, for databases using --vector-backend redis

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_LLM_MODEL.prompt: LLM model for all kb commands (overrides BLUE_DATA_LLM_MODEL)

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_SCHEMA_EXPANSION_LLM.prompt: LLM model for `blue-kb schema expand` (and expansion inside `blue-kb data extract`)

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_ENRICHMENT_LLM_MODEL.prompt: LLM model for enrichment (the MCP server's `enrich` tool)

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_INGESTION_LLM_MODEL.prompt: LLM model for `blue-kb data ingest` judges

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_SCHEMA_EXPANSION_TIM.prompt: Seconds before `blue-kb schema expand` gives up (0 = no limit)

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_EXTRACTION_EFFORT.prompt: Extraction effort — low, medium, or high (1/2/3 passes over the text)

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_EXTRACTION_MAX_CONCU.prompt: Extraction chunks to process concurrently (1 = sequential)

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_EXTRACTION_MAX_TURNS.prompt: Max agent turns per extraction stage

BLUE_DATA_KB_SOURCE_EXTRACTION_RELATED_D.prompt: Existing entities/facts surfaced to extraction as leads (0 disables)
